subject: Request: temporary pause on purge + KV log offset for upcoming audit
messages:
From: Julia Perez <julia.perez@healthbridge.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: security@healthbridge.com, legal@healthbridge.com
Date: 2028-08-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Audit window — need temporary pause & staggered purge offsets

Hi Sean,

We just received notice from our internal auditors that HealthBridge will run a targeted compliance audit the week of Aug 21. Two asks from the audit team: (1) a temporary pause on any nonstop purge activity for customer
indices for the 48 hours leading into the audit start; and (2) confirmation that we can stagger KV/log trimming for the backup chain so that a contiguous restore window of 30 days is preserved for a sample set of accounts.

Specifically we need: 
- A hold starting 2028-08-20T00:00:00Z for 48 hours on any irreversible backup prune for the HealthBridge account.
- KV log offset adjustments so the earliest tombstone in the chain for the sample datasets remains within a 30-day contiguous window (audit will validate record continuity).

Can you confirm operationally whether Redwood can: (a) apply an account-level temporary pause on backend purge jobs and (b) schedule a manual KV log trimming offset for our subprocessor chain for the dates above? If there's a cost or SLA impact please call it out.

I've attached a short evidence list and retention matrix to help.

Thanks,
Julia
Julia Perez
Director, Risk & Compliance
HealthBridge
[attachment: retention_matrix_q3.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
[attachment: requested_evidence_list.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Julia Perez <julia.perez@healthbridge.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-09T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit window — need temporary pause & staggered purge offsets

Julia — thanks for the heads up and the attachments. We're able to support this but want to confirm a few operational details so we can scope the runbook and any potential restore-window risk. High level: yes, we can gate purge jobs at the account scope and apply a KV log trim offset schedule to preserve a contiguous restore range for a chosen snapshot set.

Couple of clarifying Qs:
1) Which HealthBridge tenant(s) should we scope? (full prod: hb-prod, or a smaller sample?)
2) Do you need the hold to apply to all backup tiers (hot/cold) or only daily incremental/prune?
3) Will auditors need on-demand exports of the KV logs or just confirmation + sanitized evidence?

Operational notes for transparency:
- Applying an account-level purge pause will queue pruning jobs; those queued operations will run after the pause window unless we apply a manual rollback/accelerated prune.
- For KV log offsets we will pin the earliest tombstone by adjusting the retention marker on the backup chain; that action causes additional disk overhead and may increase snapshot egress if we create ad-hoc restore points.
- We can do the work with our standard SLA exception (no additional platform downtime) but if HealthBridge asks us to extend the contiguous window beyond 30 days we'll need a short procurement addendum for extended snapshot storage.

KM: Kimberly, Grace — are you available to pick this up? Kimberly, can you draft the purge-hold runbook? Grace, can you confirm cost/ops impact and whether we need a DocuSign DPA addendum?

I'll stand by for the tenant list from Julia and will draft a runbook skeleton once confirmed.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales (Retention & Compliance Lead)
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-09T13:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit window — need temporary pause & staggered purge offsets

Sean / Grace,

I reviewed the attachments and sketched an ops plan. Summary of the runbook steps below; I'll attach as a follow-up formal runbook doc once Sean confirms tenants.

Runbook (high-level):
1) Receive tenant list and scope identifier from client.
2) Create a temporary account-level flag (temp_retain=true) that suppresses scheduled prune jobs at the orchestration layer as of 2028-08-20T00:00Z.
3) Snapshot current KV log head and create a pinned restore marker for sample datasets (we'll call these HB-A, HB-B).
4) Apply KV log offset: backfill the incremental chain for HB-A/HB-B to maintain a contiguous 30-day window; do not compact older segments for those specific ranges.
5) Prepare sanitized evidence bundle (list of tombstone offsets, snapshot ids, and checksums) and upload to the shared drive.
6) Reconcile post-audit: remove temp_retain flag and run a controlled prune sweep with a 24-hour notification to HealthBridge.

Notes / Risk: 
- Disk utilization could increase by ~12–18% for the pinned datasets while the hold is active. If multiple customers request similar holds during the same period we may need to coordinate capacity.
- If auditors require on-demand exports of raw KV logs we will need approval from Security (PII gating) and a signed DPA amendment for raw log transfer.

I'll draft the runbook document and include a checklist and command snippets. Grace — can you estimate the cost delta (storage + manual ops hours)?

-Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Platform Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Julia Perez <julia.perez@healthbridge.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-10T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit window — need temporary pause & staggered purge offsets

Julia — quick update and confirmation from legal/finance side: we can proceed under the following terms.

Deliverables we will provide prior to audit start:
- Confirmation that temp_retain flag is set (timestamped) and scheduled prune jobs suppressed for hb-prod (if that's the tenant you pick).
- Pinned snapshot ids for HB-A and HB-B and a KV log tombstone offset listing.
- Sanitized evidence bundle uploaded to the shared Drive link in this thread.

Conditions / paperwork: 
- If auditors request raw KV log exports (including any rows with customer-identifiable metadata), HealthBridge must sign a DPA amendment that explicitly authorizes raw log transfer and includes an SFTP ingestion agreement. DocuSign link sent separately (DocuSign: 0b7c-HealthBridge-DPA-amend).
- There will be a temporary storage surcharge for pinned snapshots and suppressed compaction: estimated incremental storage cost = "$1,850" for the pause window (covers pinned datasets + manual ops). We can invoice on your next monthly statement or treat as a one-time charge.

Next steps for HealthBridge:
1) Confirm tenant scope (hb-prod or hb-prod + hb-stage).
2) Sign the DPA amendment if raw exports are likely.
3) Reply with any additional evidence requests so we can finalize the runbook by 2028-08-16 EOD.

I'll move to schedule engineering tickets once we have confirmation.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Manager, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
